set.body: Implement preprocessing as algebraic MatrixView expressions, not eager DoubleMatrix conversion. Add StoragePolicy.Operator, PreserveSparse, and AllowDense; AffineMatrixView(base, scale, shift); fitted center, scale, standardize, pass; column-subset-aware transform and inverseTransform. Acceptance: sparse scale stays sparse; sparse centering/standardization stays lazy by default; PreserveSparse rejects densifying shifts; AllowDense is explicit; rightMultiply, crossProduct, transpose-style products, and subsetting match dense arithmetic on parity fixtures from multivarious.
set.title: Multivar preprocessing: sparse-preserving affine MatrixView
